summary: The runbook edit meets P7 except its new API form: size 1000 sorted ascending with no time bound returns the oldest attempts' lines across the 7-day window, so for any app that synced more than about ten times the replaced attempt's lines are silently cut.

findings.summary: argocd.md API query (size 1000, asc, no time range) returns the oldest ~10 attempts and silently omits the current one for frequently-synced apps (fieldnotes-prd: 35 pods, ~3,500 lines in 7d)
